meta.name: sdlc-orchestrator
meta.description: Orchestrate full software-development lifecycle work from first request to release readiness. Use when the user asks to build a product, improve an existing product, rebuild a messy system, coordinate several skills, choose between greenfield and migration work, or move a broad task through intake, research, requirements, architecture, decomposition, implementation, verification, and documentation gates.

copy.tagline: 从需求到发布，自动编排整个开发流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理从想法到上线的全流程开发任务
copy.tagline_en: Orchestrate the full development journey from request to release
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage end-to-end development from idea to launch

howto.what: Claude 会把软件开发任务按阶段组织，先分类并排定技能使用顺序，每个阶段结束产出交接清单和阶段总结，明确下一步由谁负责；遇到需要用户批准或涉及生产/破坏性操作时停下等待。
howto.when: 当用户要求构建新产品、改进现有产品、重建混乱系统，或要求推进一个从需求到发布的多阶段开发任务时触发。

say.text: 我要开发一个新产品，请按需求、架构、实现、验证分阶段推进。
say.note: Claude 会制定阶段计划并排出技能使用顺序。

say.text: 老系统太乱，帮我重建，先做代码分析再定架构。
say.note: Claude 会先走代码分析，再规划重构。

say.text: 协调几个技能，完成一个从需求到发布的开发任务。
say.note: Claude 会列出技能路线和各阶段检查点。

howto.what_en: Claude organizes development work into phases, classifies the task, sequences relevant skills, produces checkpoints and handoffs after each phase; it stops before user approval or production/destructive access.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to build a new product, improve an existing product, rebuild a messy system, or move a broad multi-stage development task from request to release readiness.

say_en.text: Build a new product and run the whole software lifecycle.
say_en.note: Claude will create a phase plan and pick the skills to run.

say_en.text: My legacy system is messy. Rebuild it, with code analysis before architecture.
say_en.note: Claude starts with code analysis, then plans the rebuild.

say_en.text: Coordinate several skills to take a task from request to release.
say_en.note: Claude will give an ordered skill route and checkpoints.
